d:
Jan suraj ke sutradhar prashant kishor dvara die gae is bayan ki 'bhajpa jadyu ko khatm kar rahi hai', par bihar sarkar ke mantri shravan kumar ne apni pratikriya dete hue palatvar kiya hai.
Prashant kishor ke bayan par javab dete hue mantri shravan kumar ne kaha ki JDU ko kaun khatm karega. unhonne kaha ki jab lokasbha ka chunav aa raha tha, tab kuchh log JDU ko khatm kar rahe the aur kahte the ki parti khatm ho jaegi, lekin JDU ne 12 lokasbha siten jit lin.
